$description:
Mode-independent tokens, mirroring shadcn/ui's own theme. DTCG 2025.10. Source of truth — emits src/styles/tokens.css + src/tokens.ts via `npm run tokens`. Never hand-write a CSS variable.

Only what shadcn defines lives here. Inter is the system sans face; named type roles remain Tailwind utility mappings until the typography lab promotes them to authored tokens. Spacing, opacity, breakpoints and shadows are Tailwind defaults and need no token until something actually demands one. A type role consumed by a ported component holds shadcn's shipped value; a role nothing consumes yet holds the authored ideal. Changing a consumed value is a deliberate act that gets its own commit and its own screenshot diff — never a drive-by edit.

radius.$description: Base corner radius. shadcn derives the steps below from this with calc(); we author them explicitly because the values also have to be readable by tooling that has no calc().

motion-duration-base.$description: 150ms. Tailwind's --default-transition-duration, which system.css does not override — 33 transitions across 26 src/ui files run at it today, including Button's own base recipe. The most-used duration in the system by a wide margin, and the one you get without asking.

motion-duration-moderate.$description: 200ms. The most common DELIBERATE duration — 8 explicit duration-200 usages (accordion, dialog, alert-dialog, navigation-menu, sidebar, message-scroller).

motion-ease-linear.$description: Tailwind's ease-linear, four uses in src/ui.

motion-ease-in-out.$description: Tailwind's ease-in-out, read from node_modules/tailwindcss. One use in src/ui.

type-display.$description: Largest heading, for documentation surfaces — hero titles, landing-page headers.

type-heading-lg.$description: Largest in-app heading — page titles, top-level section headers.

type-heading.$description: Section heading — dialog titles, card titles, sub-sections.

type-heading-sm.$description: Small heading — nested sections, sidebar group titles. Line height equals font size: it sits on a single tight line, not a flowing paragraph. Tracking is normal because no src/ui title ships a tracking utility; the -0.025em on the unconsumed heading roles is the authored ideal, and collapsing the two is a deliberate change with its own commit.

type-heading-sm-loose.$description: 18px title on a normal line box — AlertDialog and Empty titles. type-heading-sm is the leading-none variant Dialog ships; these two are not the same value and are not being merged in this issue. Tracking is normal because no src/ui title ships a tracking utility; the -0.025em on the unconsumed heading roles is the authored ideal, and collapsing the two is a deliberate change with its own commit.

type-body-lg.$description: Larger body copy — lead paragraphs, empty-state descriptions.

type-body.$description: Default running text — paragraphs, descriptions, list items.

type-body-strong.$description: Emphasised inline text within body copy — same metrics as type-body, heavier weight.

type-control.$description: Button, input, tab and menu item label. 20px line height, matching the shipped text-sm control metrics.

type-control-sm.$description: Small control and micro-label — Kbd, Badge emphasis, sidebar group labels, message authors, combobox chips. 12px at weight 500, the most repeated recipe after type-control.

type-caption.$description: Secondary/supporting text — helper text, timestamps, metadata.

type-label.$description: Form field label — matches the Label component's shipped metrics (text-sm, leading-none, weight 500).

type-eyebrow.$description: Uppercase micro-label — section eyebrows, sidebar category headings. Not the Label component; form labels use type-label. Site and documentation surfaces only; no src/ui component consumes this. Do not wire a component to it — components use type-control-sm.

type-metric.$description: Large numeric statistic, for documentation surfaces — dashboards, stat cards. Tabular figures so digits don't shift width.

type-metric-sm.$description: Smaller numeric statistic — compact stat cards, inline metrics. Tabular figures so digits don't shift width.

type-code.$description: Inline and block code — monospace body text.

type-shortcut.$description: Keyboard shortcut hint in a menu — DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Menubar, Command. Weight 400 with wide tracking, which is why it is not type-control-sm.
